- **Euclidean wormhole learning page (English)**: `https://domij.info/wormholes/`. Real-time GPU RK4 null-geodesic ray-tracer (DNEG Lorentzian throat, Euclidean WKB pinch-off, reflective BTZ AdS₃ box, and ensemble/de Sitter view), paired with a 2D RK4 ray cross-section, leading Cardy–BTZ entropy, and an exact three-member teaching ensemble. Euclidean saddles carry no Lorentzian travel route; no claim that all gravity averages over theories.
- **Atmospheric Newtonian noise learning page (English)**: `https://domij.info/newtonian-noise/`. Interactive 3D air-to-test-mass simulation paired with a synchronized geometric standoff model and live camera frustum, generalized finite-Q infrasound shielding, live Appendix A.1 1D Kolmogorov cycloidal Monte Carlo FFT validation, and digitized sensitivity comparisons for aLIGO, ET, CE, TOBA and SOGRO (adapted from Wenhui Wang's 2025 UTA dissertation record and Wang & Creighton 2025, arXiv:2505.05690).
- **Globular cluster sandbox (full-screen interactive)**: https://domij.info/cluster/
- **Knowledge boundary (full-screen interactive)**: https://domij.info/knowledge/ — the same sketch as the front page, as geometry: collective human knowledge as a spiky ball, a language model growing as a smoother, lagging copy inside it, and the concepts a prompt lights up.

## Three ways into the work

In 2023 I was trying to work out which problems I could keep working on while earning a living and looking after my family. I still want to build a business that can pay its own way. When a decision helps the business survive, I also want to know who had a say and who bears the cost.

- **Back an idea.** Start with the need that led me to build for older adults. Then see what older drivers asked for in practice. [Starting a New Venture](https://domij.info/articles/substack/starting-a-new-venture.html) and [Tesla, Seniors Love Your Self-Driving—Now Let’s Make It Safer for Them](https://domij.info/articles/substack/tesla-seniors-love-your-self-drivingnow.html).
- **Build together.** Read the household agent specification alongside a field account of how older adults experience voice controls and alerts. [baby-AI: Raising a Household Agent on Edge Hardware](https://domij.info/articles/github/baby-ai.html) and [Tesla, Seniors Love Your Self-Driving—Now Let’s Make It Safer for Them](https://domij.info/articles/substack/tesla-seniors-love-your-self-drivingnow.html).
- **Learn and teach.** Pair my working draft on education with a proposed experiment on what a learner can still do after closing the chat. [Open Learning: From Individual Potential to Collective Discovery](https://domij.info/articles/blog/open-learning.html) and [Open Learning Lab: Beyond the Fluency Illusion with an 8-Agent Closed-Loop Pipeline](https://domij.info/articles/github/open-learning-lab.html).

## Open Learning — working draft

- **[Open Learning: From Individual Potential to Collective Discovery](https://domij.info/articles/blog/open-learning.html)** ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/blog/open-learning.md)) · Working draft, 17 November 2026 (bilingual EN / 中文 toggle, `?lang=zh`). Four proposed courses—effective altruism, future thinking, design thinking and positive psychology—are intended to develop purpose, potentials, communication and resilience. Three independent experience principles (informative, interactive, adaptive) apply across all four courses. Proposes individual mastery and independent or voluntary collective inquiry, with evidence, critique and revision before claims enter the commons. Not a programme evaluation or implementation claim. Includes the bilingual (EN / 中文 toggle, `?lang=zh`) decoded [Learning about Learning mind map](https://domij.info/articles/blog/learning-about-learning.html) as source context.
- **[Two people, a wider horizon](https://domij.info/shared-knowledge/)**: An interactive essay connecting education and knowledge sharing to a collaborative society. Two fictional collaborators compare schematic competence maps, disclose context, check an interpretation, align on a question, examine synthetic evidence and prepare a local provisional note. Common topics are not checked understanding; neither agreement nor a quiz certifies mastery or truth. Negative results can contribute. No real profiles, model downloads or publication. [Open Learning draft](https://domij.info/articles/blog/open-learning.html).
- [我对未来教育的期待](https://domij.info/future-of-education/) is the short Chinese introduction to the [full working draft in English](https://domij.info/articles/blog/open-learning.html) and [Chinese](https://domij.info/articles/blog/open-learning.html?lang=zh#zh). It summarises the four proposed courses, three experience principles, independent and collaborative inquiry, and five questions about learning, agency, collaboration, resilience and cost. Open Learning Lab and the older-adult essays appear as related reading.

## About

I work on machine learning and decision systems. My background is in computational astrophysics; my current interests are learning, human judgement and how people work together.

The four scales of this site run from a million stars to the person sitting next to you: science and its humanities held in one conversation. The first scale is a complex adaptive system read from the outside in; the rest turn the same grammar of interaction and feedback on traffic, auctions, tools and teams.

## Background

### Computational astrophysics
Ph.D. Physics (2013–2018) · LSST Data Science Fellow

I began in computational astrophysics, studying stellar dynamics and binary black holes through numerical simulation and statistical modelling.

- Numerical simulations of globular clusters using N-body and Monte Carlo methods (3,240 MOCCA simulations across 662,772 globular clusters in 8,946 galaxies within 30 Mpc).
- [Globular cluster sandbox](https://domij.info/cluster/): a full-screen interactive model of the same physics — 1,650 stars evolving under gravitational relaxation and mass segregation, with colour, luminosity, radius and lifetime from MESA-based stellar-evolution relations, alongside the LISA strain and standard-siren localization for the dynamically formed binary black holes. The premise it was built to test: black holes formed dynamically inside a cluster are ejected into the halo, far from the local Galactic potential that perturbs every other timing clock, and so survive as unperturbed standard sirens — which, paired with an electromagnetic counterpart, make each one a multi-messenger probe of dark matter.
- Analysis of binary black hole evolution (17,883,760 inspiralling BBHs and 86,939 mergers), deriving a lower-bound local merger event rate of η ≃ 587 Gpc⁻³ yr⁻¹ and identifying 17 extragalactic standard sirens localized by LISA within ΔV ≤ 1 Mpc³ ([Dissertation essay chapter](https://domij.info/articles/research/astrophysics-bbh-dissertation.html) · [Full PDF](https://domij.info/pdfs/main.pdf)).
- LSST Data Science Fellowship: statistical modelling, image processing and reproducible research workflows.

### Decision systems
Applied ML & Decision Intelligence (2018–2024)

I then worked on machine learning for consumer products, marketplaces and advertising, where a model has to be useful within the constraints of a working system.

- Recommendation systems using behavioural and contextual signals from mobility data.
- Marketplace pricing, generative AI request workflows and information exchange between users.
- Advertising analytics, model evaluation and causal attribution; published architecture notes on real-time bidding and multi-agent control.

### Learning and human–AI collaboration
Independent projects & ventures (2018–present)

Building a company brought me closer to the people using the technology. It made me more attentive to what they need, and to the gap between a promising idea and something useful.

- Kin Domi, Inc.: AI and community projects concerned with older adults’ independence and access to technology.
- Open Learning Lab and baby-AI: open research into learning, and specifications for a household agent that runs on local hardware.
- Essays on learning, team coordination and human–AI collaboration in Domi’s Mind Waves and elsewhere.

## A question I keep returning to

What helps people make better decisions, learn well and work together?

## How I work

- **Working together**: Good work depends on more than individual ability. Shared context, trust, complementary skills and sensible incentives matter, as does room for people to exercise their own judgement.
- **Usefulness**: I judge technology by what it helps people do: understand a problem, make a choice, learn a skill or spend their time better. Technical elegance is valuable when it serves that purpose.
- **Testing the idea**: I try to make assumptions explicit, build something that can be tested and pay attention to the result. Revising an explanation is part of the work.

## Questions I am exploring

These are ongoing questions. The linked work distinguishes observations, proposals and research findings.

- **Collective Intelligence**: How do individual capabilities combine to produce collective outcomes?
- **Human–AI Collaboration**: How can intelligent systems support human judgement and agency?
- **Organisational Intelligence**: How do communication, coordination, trust, and incentives shape collaboration?
- **Complex Adaptive Systems**: How do interactions among individuals give rise to emergent social and organisational behaviour?
- **Decision Intelligence**: How can information, feedback, and experimentation improve decisions?
- **Human Potential**: How can technology make learning, opportunity, and meaningful participation more accessible?
- **AI and Society**: How might increasingly capable intelligence change the ways we work, cooperate, and live?

## Selected projects

Research notes, software and specifications at different stages of development. Design targets are not measured results; consult the linked work for evidence and status.

- **[Open Learning Lab](https://domij.info/articles/github/open-learning-lab.html)** ([GitHub](https://github.com/domijin/open-learning-lab)): An open research ledger and proposed experiment protocol comparing approaches to learning with language models, focusing on delayed recall and independent transfer rather than completed trial outcomes.
- **[baby-AI](https://domij.info/articles/github/baby-ai.html)** ([GitHub](https://github.com/domijin/baby-AI)): Eight subsystem specifications covering system charter, perception, speech recognition, memory, interaction, evaluation, privacy and escalation. The specification targets local hardware (~$100–$150 BOM) with signed evaluation records; it is a design specification, not a shipped hardware product.
- **[Life Hack: iMessage as a Low-Bandwidth Router to the Internet](https://domij.info/articles/blog/imessage-ai-router.html)** ([Beta page](https://domij.info/beta/)): An experiment in using iMessage to reach internet-connected agents when normal browsing is limited. It explores how a familiar, asynchronous interface can work with constrained connections.
- **[Kin Domi, Inc.](https://kindomi.net/)** ([Founder’s log](https://domij.info/articles/substack/starting-a-new-venture.html)): Venture incorporated in December 2024 around accessible interfaces, AI tools and community activities in Palo Alto, informed by older adults’ experiences of technology, mobility and learning.
- **[Advertising decision systems](https://domij.info/articles/github/observations-in-advertising.html)** ([GitHub](https://github.com/domijin/observations_in_advertising)): Notes on ad-serving architecture, real-time bidding constraints, advertising economics and the growth trap.
- **[LibertyEarth & The Future Project](https://domij.info/articles/github/libertyearth-and-future.html)** ([GitHub](https://github.com/domijin/LibertyEarth)): An evolving collection of proposals about social contracts, liquid democracy, local manufacturing and ways of turning ideas into practical experiments.
